use_case: Small business credit underwriting model: scores applications up to $500,000 and returns a recommendation and the top 4 reason codes to the loan origination system
vendor_or_model: AI model vendor (gradient-boosted machine learning model), deployed by the bank as the credit decisioning service in the production account (SYS-10)
data_categories: Business deposit cash-flow data from the core; business credit bureau data; principal owners' personal credit scores; time in business; industry code; loan amount, term, and collateral; business location (ZIP code) (customer information and NPI)
human_in_the_loop: Loan officer makes and documents every decision; from 2026-10-01 a second credit officer reviews every model-recommended decline before notice
applicable_laws: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.4, 1002.5(b), 1002.6, 1002.9); GLBA and the Interagency Guidelines (12 CFR 30 App. B, including III.D); bank model risk management policy
status: In production since 2025-10 at all 28 branches; approved to continue with conditions; version changes frozen until validation

use_case: AML transaction monitoring alert scoring: ranks alerts and suppresses those scored below a threshold
vendor_or_model: AML monitoring provider (machine learning scoring module in SYS-13)
data_categories: Transactions from the core and payments hub; customer due diligence data; SAR history (Restricted)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (BSA investigations); human analysts decide on SARs and account actions
human_in_the_loop: BSA analysts review every alert above threshold; quarterly sample of suppressed alerts from 2026 Q4
applicable_laws: Bank Secrecy Act SAR rules (12 CFR 21.11; 31 CFR 1020.320); GLBA and the Interagency Guidelines; bank model risk management policy
status: In production since 2024; below-threshold testing annual only; quarterly sampling added

use_case: Online banking login and transaction fraud scoring by the digital banking provider (device and behavior risk scores that trigger step-up checks or holds)
vendor_or_model: Digital banking provider (embedded machine learning service)
data_categories: Customer device, sign-in, and transaction data (NPI)
consequential_decision_category: None (fraud prevention; holds reviewed by staff)
human_in_the_loop: Treasury operations review held transactions and release or return them the same business day
applicable_laws: GLBA and the Interagency Guidelines (III.C.1.f; III.D); Identity Theft Red Flags (12 CFR 41.90); Regulation E error resolution for consumer transfers (12 CFR 1005.11)
status: In production; provider model documentation requested (P09 VEN-02)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for staff (drafting, summarizing policies and procedures) under an enterprise contract with data protections
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI service (large language model) with a no-training and data-retention clause
data_categories: Internal information; customer information prohibited during the pilot
human_in_the_loop: Staff check every output before use (POL-05 4.10); no connection to customer systems
applicable_laws: GLBA and the Interagency Guidelines (customer information only in approved systems); POL-04 and POL-05
status: Pilot with 25 users since 2026-06; started without review; now approved as Low with conditions; public tools blocked from 2026-12-31

use_case: Customer service chatbot on the website and mobile app: answers product, fee, and branch questions and routes customers to agents
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (generative AI over an approved knowledge base)
data_categories: Customer free-text messages (may contain NPI); no account access
consequential_decision_category: None directly; can influence customer actions on fees, disputes, and fraud reports
human_in_the_loop: Hand-off to a live agent on request or on detected fraud, dispute, or complaint topics; monthly transcript sampling from 2026-11
applicable_laws: GLBA and the Interagency Guidelines; Regulation E error resolution (12 CFR 1005.11) must not be discouraged; unfair or deceptive practices law
status: In production since 2026-03; started without compliance or model risk review; conditions due 2026-11-30
